title: Protocol for Use with Large Insert Libraries (470–520 bp)
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfu2jnye
materials: DNA Preparation Starting materials is 10 ng-200 ng DNA Combine 10 ng-200 ng of genomic DNA with control DNA, CpG methylated pUC19 (lilac) and unmethylated lambda DNA (lilac) in 50 µL made up with 0.1X TE pH 8 . The amount of control DNA added is dependent on the number of reads required. If checking library quality on a MiSeq ® (2–4 M reads per library) prior to deep sequencing on NovaSeq ® , HiSeq ® or NextSeq ® (100–500 M reads per library) then the amount of controls spiked to the sample DNA is higher than what is required for direct deep sequencing. Having higher ng of control DNA for samples that are sequenced on a MiSeq ensures that there are enough control reads to accurately call cytosine conversion. We recommend this for users who are inexperienced with next generation sequencing library preparation. For libraries sequenced to a depth of 2–4 M paired end reads, approximately 5,000 x 76 base paired end reads of unmethylated lambda and 500 x 76 base paired end reads of CpG methylated pUC19 are needed to give enough reads for accurate conversion estimates. If these same libraries are sequenced to a higher depth of 200–400 M reads per library, then the number of reads associated with the controls would be in vast excess, 500,000 for unmethylated lambda and 50,000 for pUC19. Recommended Control Inputs: Pre-sequencing on MiSeq prior to deep sequencing on NovaSeq, HiSeq or NextSeq: spike in 1 μl of 0.1 ng/μl pUC19 control DNA (lilac) and 1 μl of 2 ng/μl unmethylated lambda DNA (lilac) per 10–200 ng sample DNA. Direct Sequencing on NovaSeq, HiSeq or NextSeq: Dilute the pUC19 (lilac) and the unmethylated lambda control (lilac) 1:100 using 0.1X TE, pH 8.0. Spike in 1 μl diluted pUC19 (0.001 ng) control DNA and 1 μl diluted unmethylated lambda DNA (0.02 ng) per 10–200 ng sample DNA

The DNA can be denatured using either Formamide or 0.1 N Sodium Hydroxide. Use option A for denaturing using Formamide and option B for denaturing using 0.1 N Sodium hydroxide. Option A: Formamide (Recommended) Pre-heat thermocycler to 85 °C . Add 4 µL, Formamide to the 16 µL, of oxidized DNA . Vortex to mix or by pipetting up and down at least 10 times, centrifuge briefly. Incubate at 85 °C for 00:10:00 in the pre-heated thermocycler with the heated lid on. Immediately place On ice . Proceed immediately to the next section. Option B: Sodium Hydroxide (Optional, see FAQ about preparing NaOH) Prepare freshly diluted 0.1 N NaOH. Pre-heat thermocycler to 50 °C with the heated lid set to ≥ 60 °C or on. Add 4 µL, 0.1 N NaOH to the 16 µL . Vortex to mix or by pipetting up and down at least 10 times, centrifuge briefly. Incubate at 50 °C for 00:10:00 in the pre-heated thermocycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 60 °C or on. Immediately place on ice. Proceed immediately to the next section.

steps.title: Shear DNA
steps.instruction: Fragment 50 µL of genomic DNA and control DNAs to an average insert size of 350–400 bp (for a 470–520 bp final Illumina library) using a device such as a Covaris instrument. Do not use enzymatic fragmentation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the 50 µL of sheared DNA to a new PCR tube for End Prep.

steps.title: Perform End Prep
steps.instruction: Mix the required components in a sterile nuclease-free PCR tube on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix the volume by pipetting up and down at least 10 times using a 100 µL or 200 µL pipette set to 50 µL.
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid.
Incubate in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 75 °C (or on) using the following program: 30 minutes at 20 °C, 30 minutes at 65 °C, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Ligate Adaptors
steps.instruction: Add Ligation Enhancer and Ligation Master Mix to the 60 µL End Prep reaction mixture on ice and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Mix the volume by pipetting up and down at least 10 times using a 100 µL or 200 µL pipette set to 80 µL.
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid.
Incubate at 20 °C for 15 minutes in a thermocycler with the heated lid off.

steps.title: Purify Ligation Products
steps.instruction: Clean the DNA using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend.
Add 110 µL of resuspended beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand; after 5 minutes (or when solution is clear), discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol while on the magnetic stand.
Repeat the ethanol wash once (total of two washes), removing all visible liquid with a p10 tip after the second wash.
Air-dry beads for up to 2 minutes on the magnetic stand; elute when beads are dark brown and glossy but all liquid has evaporated.
Remove tubes from stand and elute by adding 29 µL of Elution Buffer (white).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at room temperature.
Quick spin if necessary, place on magnetic stand, and after 3 minutes (or when clear), transfer 28 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Prepare TET2 Buffer
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the TET2 Reaction Buffer Supplement powder by centrifuging first.

substeps.instruction: Option A (E7120S/E7120G): Add 100 µL of TET2 Reaction Buffer to one tube of supplement and mix well.
Option B (E7120L): Add 400 µL of TET2 Reaction Buffer to one tube of supplement and mix well.
Store reconstituted buffer at -20 °C and discard after 4 months.

steps.title: Oxidize 5mC/5hmC
steps.instruction: Add reaction components to the 28 µL EM-seq adaptor ligated DNA on ice, mix by vortexing, and centrifuge briefly.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 500 mM Fe(II) Solution (yellow) by adding 1 µL to 1249 µL of water; use immediately.
Combine Diluted Fe(II) Solution and EM-seq DNA with Oxidation Enzymes; mix by vortexing or pipetting up and down 10 times, then centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 45 °C (or on).
Transfer samples to ice and add 1 µL of Stop Reagent (yellow); mix by vortexing or pipetting up and down 10 times and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes, then at 4 °C in the thermocycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 45 °C (or on).

steps.title: Purify Oxidized DNA
steps.instruction: Clean the DNA using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend.
Add 90 µL of resuspended beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand; after 5 minutes (or when clear), discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol; incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once (total of two washes), removing all visible liquid with a p10 tip.
Air-dry beads for up to 2 minutes; elute when beads are dark brown and glossy.
Remove tubes from stand and elute by adding 17 µL of Elution Buffer (white).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand and after 3 minutes (or when clear), transfer 16 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Perform Deamination
steps.instruction: Add reaction components to 20 µL of denatured DNA on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by vortexing or pipetting up and down 10 times, then centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C for 3 hours, then at 4 °C in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 45 °C (or on).

steps.title: Purify Deaminated DNA
steps.instruction: Clean the DNA using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Caution: do not over-dry as beads become difficult to resuspend).

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend.
Add 100 µL of resuspended beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand; after 5 minutes (or when clear), discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol; incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once (total of two washes), removing all visible liquid with a p10 tip.
Air-dry beads for up to 90 seconds; elute when beads are dark brown and glossy.
Remove tubes from stand and elute by adding 21 µL of Elution Buffer (white).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand and after 3 minutes (or when clear), transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Add reaction components to 20 µL of deaminated DNA on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by vortexing or pipetting up and down 10 times, then centrifuge briefly.
Perform PCR amplification in a thermocycler using the specified cycling conditions.

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR products using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend.
Add 90 µL of water to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand; after 5 minutes (or when clear), discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of 80% freshly prepared ethanol; incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once (total of two washes), removing all visible liquid with a p10 tip.
Air-dry beads for up to 2 minutes; elute when beads are dark brown and glossy.
Remove tubes from stand and elute by adding 21 µL of Elution Buffer (white), 21 µL of TE (10 mM Tris, 0.1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0), or low TE.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times and incubate for at least 1 minute at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand and after 3 minutes (or when clear), transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Quality Control and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Analyze and sequence the final libraries.

substeps.instruction: Determine size distribution and concentration using a Bioanalyzer or TapeStation.
Sequence using the preferred Illumina platform (2 x 100 base reads or 2 x 150 base reads for large insert libraries).

steps.title: Additional Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a final bead cleanup if required.

substeps.instruction: Add 91 µL of resuspended NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to each sample; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds before removing and discarding the supernatant.
